children.text: Notification surface chosen by stakes — transient toast for low-stakes (MIDI lost: loops keep playing), persistent non-dismissable banner for immediate-action (audio device lost: nothing is heard); never two bars for one cause — the audio banner absorbs the engine-stopped message. (Owner decision, 2026-08-26.) This supersedes the earlier three-bar in-flow stack and the two-banner device+MIDI spike: the audio-device-lost banner now stands alone in the record red with tight copy and an inline action (Open setup), standing in place of the engine-stopped bar rather than stacking with it; the MIDI-lost case moves to a bottom toast in warning amber (see STAGE / midi-lost-toast), no action, self-dismissing when the controller returns. Neither ever appears as a dialog: a lost interface mid-song must not also steal the transport. The 7-inch readout echoes the audio line in its status strip — the performer is looking down, not at this screen.
